coordinates.locator: OpenStreetMap/Nominatim record of way 340213340, CERN - Point 1 (ATLAS) (reused anchor, about 480 m from the tunnel; it does not itself describe TI12)
coordinates.note: REVIEW REQUIRED, after real effort: no CERN geodetic/survey publication giving WGS84 coordinates for the FASER/TI12 tunnel location was found (home.cern and the INSPIRE experiment record state only the distance/direction from ATLAS IP1, not coordinates; a Nominatim/OpenStreetMap search for the tunnel name returned only generic CERN-campus results, not a point specific to this tunnel). FASER is stated to be 480 m downstream of the ATLAS interaction point in the unused service tunnel TI12 (src:colliders-lhc-faser-inspire-experiment-record, corroborated independently by home.cern/science/experiments/faser). As a placeholder, this record reuses the numeric coordinate value already sourced for site:cern-point-1-atlas (46.2355606, 6.0546968), the nearest existing sourced CERN point, since the detector is only ~480 m from that point -- well inside this record's widened precision_m. Per v0.2 A23, kind is 'campus' (not 'detector') since no rank<=7 source gives a surveyed hall position; confidence is 'uncertain' and this note documents the gap, which the validator accepts as a warning-level approximate placement (coordinate-kind-approximate) rather than an error. VERIFIER FIX (2026-09-17): removed a self-contradictory earlier sentence that asserted, in this same note, both that 'kind is kept as detector' and that 'kind is kept as campus'; the field's actual value has always been 'campus' and only that is now stated.

name: TI12 tunnel (FASER)
notes: TI12 is a former LEP-era transfer tunnel, 480 m downstream of ATLAS interaction point 1, reused to house the FASER detector.
REVIEW REQUIRED: coordinate is a reused neighbouring-point placeholder (kind: campus, confidence: uncertain); see coordinates.note.

summary.plain: An unused service tunnel at CERN, 480 metres from the ATLAS collision point, that now holds the FASER experiment, searching for rare particles thrown straight down the beamline.
summary.technical: TI12, a former LEP transfer tunnel 480 m downstream of LHC interaction point 1 along the beam collision axis; houses the FASER detector, installed during Long Shutdown 2 (2019-2021).
